faq.a: Each treatment page shows a “starting from” price. Your final price depends on your medical assessment and is confirmed in a written quote before you travel. There are no hidden costs.

faq.q: What is included in the package?
faq.a: Packages typically include consultation and tests, the procedure, hotel stay, VIP transfers, an interpreter, medication and an aftercare kit, and remote follow-up. Your quote lists every item.

faq.q: How long do I need to stay in Türkiye?
faq.a: It depends on the treatment. Each treatment page shows the usual length of stay, and your coordinator confirms it in your plan.
Procedures are performed under appropriate anaesthesia. You may feel discomfort during recovery; your doctor will explain what to expect and prescribe medication if needed.
Recovery time differs by treatment and by patient. Your doctor gives you a personal recovery timeline and written aftercare instructions.

faq.q: When will I see the final results?
faq.a: Results develop over time and vary between patients. Your doctor explains the expected timeline for your treatment during your consultation.

faq.q: Is it safe to have treatment in Türkiye?
faq.a: Safety depends on the clinic, not the country. Check the licence, the doctors' credentials and the hygiene standards. Ours are listed on the About & Safety and Doctors pages.
Your coordinator communicates with you in your language, and an interpreter is with you at the clinic.
Payment options and the payment schedule are set out in your written quote. Ask your coordinator which methods are available.

faq.q: What happens after I go home?
faq.a: You stay in touch with your coordinator by WhatsApp. You send progress photos and we arrange follow-up calls with your doctor.

transplant.name: Hair Transplant
transplant.short: Scalp, beard, eyebrow and moustache transplants, and hair restoration in scars.

treatment.name: Hair Treatments
treatment.short: Non-surgical treatments for thinning hair and a healthier scalp.

techniques.label: Our techniques
techniques.sub: Both are modern follicular unit techniques that leave no linear scar. Your doctor recommends one of them, or a combination, after examining your donor area, hair type and goals.

fue.name: FUE
fue.d: Follicular units are extracted one by one from the donor area with a micro-punch. The doctor then opens tiny channels in the recipient area and places the grafts into them.
steps: Individual extraction with a 0.7–1.0 mm micro-punch
Recipient channels opened at the planned angle and density
best: Larger areas of thinning or baldness
A higher number of grafts in one session
Patients who are happy to shave the treatment area

dhi.name: DHI
dhi.d: Extraction is the same as in FUE. The difference is implantation: each graft is loaded into an implanter pen (Choi pen), which creates the channel and places the graft in a single step.
steps: Individual extraction with a micro-punch, as in FUE
Each graft loaded into a Choi implanter pen
Channel and implantation in one motion, controlling angle, depth and direction
best: Hairline design and adding density between existing hair
Keeping the recipient area unshaved, when suitable

head: FUE
DHI
rows: Channels opened first, then grafts placed
The pen opens the channel and implants in one step
The recipient area can often stay unshaved
Suited to precise work and adding density
Tiny dot scars, no linear scar

techniques.fact: Good to know: DHI is a variation of FUE, not a competing operation. Studies have not shown that either technique reliably gives better results. Surgical skill, planning and graft handling matter most.
techniques.clinicH: How we apply FUE and DHI

clinic.d: Your doctor examines your donor area, designs the hairline with you and chooses FUE, DHI or a combination.
Grafts are counted, sorted and kept in a cooled storage solution so their time out of the body is as short as possible.
Each graft is placed following the natural angle and direction of your own hair.
Extraction is spread evenly so your donor area keeps a natural density for the future.

techniques.timelineH: What to expect after either technique

timeline.d: The transplanted hairs usually shed. This is a normal part of the hair growth cycle.
New hair usually starts to grow.
The final result is usually visible; the crown can take the longest.

techniques.note: Individual results vary. Your doctor will explain realistic expectations for your case.
